title: Sajad Lone urges scientific scrutiny of Sheshnag works, warns against NC-PDP blame game

ai.summary: Peoples Conference president Sajad Lone described alleged construction near Sheshnag Lake as an ecological disaster and urged environmentalists to provide scientific evidence to prevent further damage, warning that political blame games between National Conference and Peoples Democratic Party could divert attention from environmental concerns.

facts.claim: Sajad Lone described the alleged construction activity near Sheshnag Lake as an ecological disaster
facts.quote: Srinagar, Nov 25: Peoples Conference president Sajad Lone on Wednesday described the alleged construction activity near Sheshnag Lake as an ecological disaster and urged environmentalists to bring scientific evidence into the public discourse to prevent further damage.

facts.claim: Lone warned that the National Conference and the Peoples Democratic Party had begun trading allegations
facts.quote: Reacting to the controversy over the reported road construction and excavation near the high-altitude lake, Lone said the National Conference and the Peoples Democratic Party had begun trading allegations, warning that the political blame game could divert attention from the environmental concerns.

facts.claim: Lone said PDP president Mehbooba Mufti had referred to an official meeting in which, she alleged, the National Conference had supported the road project
facts.quote: In a post on X, Lone said PDP president Mehbooba Mufti had referred to an official meeting in which, she alleged, the National Conference had supported the road project.

facts.claim: Lone called on environmentalists to come forward with scientific facts and build a debate based on evidence
facts.quote: He called on environmentalists to come forward with scientific facts and build a debate based on evidence to address the ecological concerns surrounding Sheshnag.

facts.claim: Lone warned that the issue could also acquire an electoral angle ahead of the Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections
facts.quote: Expressing concern over a possible political dimension to the current controversy, he speculated that the issue could also acquire an electoral angle ahead of the Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections, which he said were approaching in about two months.

ai.background_note: Sajad Lone, president of the Peoples Conference, raised concerns about construction near Sheshnag Lake in Kashmir, linking the issue to past political conflicts and environmental concerns.
